page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.12xlarge is a storage-optimized instance featuring 48 vCPUs and 24 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8559C processor running at 3.6 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed by the Nitro hypervisor, this server includes 384 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz and a substantial 30,000 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The network interface provides a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong memory and computational performance. The instance achieves top-tier results in Geekbench single-core and multi-core tests, alongside strong memory bandwidth metrics for both cached and uncached read/write operations. However, performance tradeoffs are evident in large-scale workloads; while LLM inference speeds are strong to top-tier for small and medium models, they drop to average levels for large 70B models, reflecting the lack of dedicated GPU hardware.

This hardware profile is highly resource-dense, offering a qualitative cost-efficiency advantage for IOPS-heavy and data-intensive applications that require massive local storage alongside high memory capacity. The combination of 30 TB NVMe SSD storage, DDR5 memory, and advanced Intel instruction sets like AMX and AVX-512 makes this instance well-suited for large relational databases, NoSQL databases, real-time data indexing, and memory-cached web serving.
